info.name: Redfin Data Center CSV Export Valuation API

params.name: accessLevel
params.description: The access level for the request, controlling the detail of data returned. Common value is 1.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of AVM data to retrieve, such as estimate type or valuation model variant.

items.docs: Retrieves historical automated valuation model (AVM) data for a property, including Redfin Estimate history over time. Returns time-series data showing estimated property values at various points in history.
